_help.purpose: Tracks all 27 enterprise agentic system items across sessions and tools (opencode, cline, etc.).
_help.how_to_resume: Read this file. Find first item with status 'pending' or 'in_progress'. Check branch field and checkout. Continue work.

items.title: Operations PR fix
items.description: Show all PRs (closed + open), CI status badges, branch links in Operations page
items.ui_surface: Operations page PR table
items.notes: Created /api/agentic-console/pull-requests route using gh CLI. Enhanced PR table with CI status, review status, state badge, and GitHub link.

items.title: QA dashboard split + Req Quality
items.description: Fix 200% bug, split into 3 sub-pages (KPIs, Tests, Defects), add Req Quality Status table Green/Yellow/Red per REQ-ID, clickable % → traceability
items.ui_surface: 3 sub-pages under /quality/ with tab nav

items.title: Multi-project state directory
items.description: 00_state_ledger/projects/{id}/ per project, projects_index.json, all API routes accept ?project= param
items.ui_surface: Nav bar project dropdown, / route global train view, ?project=X routing
items.notes: Foundation for all per-project pages. Routes: / (global), /?project=X (project-specific)

items.title: Dashboard restructure
items.description: Global pipeline view (all projects as mini trains) + per-project dashboard. Project selector. Rename to 'Central Agentic AI Console'
items.ui_surface: / global train view, /project/[id] per-project

items.title: Tool/Function registry
items.description: tool_registry.json with name, description, input/output schema, endpoint. Agents invoke structured tools. Supervisor validates and routes. Agent Detail: MCP tab shows tool call log
items.ui_surface: New Tools nav item, Agent Detail MCP tab enhanced with call log

items.title: Supervisor auto-recovery + dependency cascade
items.description: Extend existing monitor route: stuck detection → RCA log → auto-relaunch (up to max_retries) → dependency cascade (downstream set to pending on breaking change) → escalate on exhaustion
items.ui_surface: AgentMiniCard attempt badge, Agent Detail cascade section, Bottom bar escalation alerts
items.notes: Extends existing /api/agentic-console/monitor route and SSE events

items.title: Retry policy + Dead Letter Queue
items.description: Per-agent retry_policy: { max_retries, backoff_s, multiplier }. Supervisor executes backoff, writes to DLQ on exhaustion. DLQ shows in Bottom bar
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Logs tab retry timeline, Flyout Run Config retry badge, Bottom Bar DLQ section

items.title: Escalation matrix
items.description: escalation_rules.json: on max retries exhausted → route to human by severity. P1→gatekeeper, P2→email, P3→log
items.ui_surface: Bottom Bar 'Escalated' section with severity badge, Supervisor banner escalation count

items.title: Agent templates with dependency picker
items.description: Add Agent modal → select template → pick deps → pick input/output artifacts → override guardrails → inject into state
items.ui_surface: Agent Grid page + Add Agent button

items.title: Versioned outputs + smart cascade
items.description: output_version, compatibility: backward-compatible|breaking. Breaking = cascade reset. Compatible = notify only
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Output Versions collapsible, cascade history

items.title: A2A structured message protocol
items.description: Typed messages: DelegateSubTask, SubTaskResult, RequestClarification. Schema-validated
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Comm tab enhanced with type badges, filter dropdown

items.title: Per-agent memory store
items.description: memory_store.jsonl per agent. Supervisor injects relevant context into next prompt
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Overview tab: 'Agent Memory' expandable, Inject toggle

items.title: Code review skip fix
items.description: Handle large diffs in pre-commit hook (focused hunk review, skip if > max)
items.ui_surface: No UI. Hook logs skipped files

items.title: Nav + breadcrumbs all pages
items.description: Sticky breadcrumb, jump-to section pills on every page
items.ui_surface: All pages

items.title: Jira integration
items.description: Read Epics/Stories/Tasks/Bugs from Jira via REST API. Show in Operations and Program Mgmt pages
items.ui_surface: Operations page Jira board embed, Program Mgmt Jira Sync section

items.title: Agent Grid page polish
items.description: Inline Approve/Reject on cards, status filter tabs, bulk select + action bar
items.ui_surface: Agent Grid page

items.title: Config/prompt versioning
items.description: Snapshot prompt + config per execution. Side-by-side diff view. Revert button
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Prompts tab: version dropdown, Compare view, Revert button

items.title: SLA tracking
items.description: Per-agent expected_duration_ms. Alert on overdue. Dashboard shows Overdue vs On Track
items.ui_surface: AgentMiniCard SLA indicator, Supervisor banner SLA count

items.title: DAG workflow engine
items.description: workflow_dag.json with conditionals, forks, dynamic routing. Supervisor walks DAG not phases
items.ui_surface: Dashboard pipeline graph (enhanced pipeline-graph.tsx)

items.title: Recursive sub-task spawning
items.description: Agent emits subtask events → Supervisor spawns sub-agents → parent synthesizes results
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Logs tab: tree view of parent+sub-steps

items.title: Output evaluation/regression
items.description: eval_rules per agent. Supervisor runs eval after compliance. Score badge
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Overview: eval score badge, per-rule pass/fail

items.title: Observability / tracing
items.description: trace_id + span_id per step. traces.jsonl. Trace view in dashboard
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Logs tab: Trace toggle → step timeline

items.title: Multi-tenant / RBAC
items.description: JWT auth. Roles: admin, gatekeeper, viewer. Project-level access
items.ui_surface: Login page, role badge in nav, restricted buttons per role

items.title: Jira auto-sync
items.description: Supervisor transitions Jira issues on agent completion
items.ui_surface: Operations page: sync status indicator, manual Sync Now button

items.title: GitHub code review in console
items.description: Show PR review comments, approval status, PR-Agent output in Agent Detail
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Overview: Code Review section with PR link

items.title: Agent health dashboard
items.description: Charts: error rate, avg duration, success rate per agent over time
items.ui_surface: New /health page

items.title: Inter-agent debate/consensus
items.description: Two agents deliberate → consensus or escalate. For architecture/design gates
items.ui_surface: Agent Detail Comm tab: Debate message type, pro/con, consensus badge
